purpose: One row per image: where it came from, who approved it, what it claims, how it is labelled and where it is in the pipeline. Checked by tools/check_images.mjs and by node --test.

states.candidate: real photograph approved but the file is not in the repository
states.ingested: original is in src/img-original; no web copies yet
states.ready: web copies built and listed in the manifest; not yet placed

classes.own-post: frame or photo from Mbanda’s own public post
classes.generated-scenery: AI, no Mbanda (scenery, objects or other adults)

mbanda.by: Mbanda Shyaka, who told his son (the site owner and web builder) to generate and publish

pci.by: Pamodzi Community Initiative (PCI). It is Mbanda's company, so his direction covers it.

decisions.text: Mbanda Shyaka directed his son, the site owner and web builder, to generate the labelled AI set and to use the 22 archive candidates. No further approval is needed.
PCI is Mbanda's company. Its photographs from the archive (church appeal 42, campus 52, and the PCI items already on the site) fall under the same direction.
The three full-size walking photographs (22-23, 22-24, 22-29) have no recorded date. Publish them with no date, place or walk named.
The 28 October ten-image test is not used.

Generator: ChatGPT Images, run in the ChatGPT app so several reference photographs can be attached. The Zapier ChatGPT action offers only GPT Image 1 and 1.5 and one source image, so it is used only for scenery and objects, if at all.

generation.note: Made from four repository photographs, not the Drive reference pack. Retire once the remakes pass the review gate.
